look_here_first: Tall robust ironweed with broader rough leaves and broad terminal arrays of purple discoid heads. Leaves are much broader than in V. lindheimeri.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad ovate to lance-ovate rough leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad flattened to irregular terminal arrays

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: purple discoid heads with no rays

lookalikes.differences: V. lindheimeri is much narrower-leaved with strongly revolute margins and densely woolly lower surfaces.
